title: Held items panel
description: A separate Held items panel for what a seat holds besides action cards and secret objectives: promissory notes (in hand, faceup, given, Support for the Throne, Alliance), relics and relic fragments, exhaustable technologies, unit upgrades and faction technologies, leaders, faction abilities and breakthrough, legendary planet abilities and attachments on controlled planets. Reached from a button with a count badge next to the card counts of each seat in the player sheet. A full-height sheet with sticky section headers on a phone, a wide two-column panel beside the player column on desktop that stays open. Other seats are read-only and public only. Mocked fixtures; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- FQ.

notes.title: Data
notes.text: No new view fields. The panel reads PlayerView (technologies, relics, fragments, leaders, exhausted_legendary, exploration_cards), the board view (controlled planets, attachments) and the promissory fields of the engine state passed through in the snapshot (promissory_notes, promissory_faceup, support_holders, faction_marks). Rules version, checksum and decision hashes are untouched.

notes.title: Privacy
notes.text: Notes in hand and faction markers are only read for the viewing seat. For other seats and spectators only faceup notes and Support for the Throne are used, the same subset as the engine's Observed::promissory_notes.
